intro: Libya has Africa's largest proven oil reserves, and oil pays for almost everything.

chapters.title: Oil
text: Oil and gas make up nearly all exports, mainly to Europe. Fighting has often shut oil fields and ports.

chapters.title: Water
text: The Great Man-Made River is one of the largest water projects in the world.

keyTerms.meaning: Oil known to be in the ground.

cardGroups.title: Made in Libya
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Libya makes and sells to the world.
